headline: Trace each learner-facing sentence back to a source packet or a no-source rule.
copy: The trace contract helps reviewers spot unsupported claims before an answer is promoted.

fields.name: Intent
fields.why: What the learner is actually asking.

fields.name: Source packet
fields.why: The cited passage and source family that can carry the answer.

fields.name: Answer sentence
fields.why: The exact learner-facing sentence being reviewed.

fields.name: Boundary
fields.why: What the answer must not imply.

fields.name: Reviewer state
fields.why: Draft, revised, approved, held, or no-source.

records.title: Steady action
records.summary: Supports a practical answer about acting steadily while not turning outcomes into identity.
records.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, medical advice, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

records.title: Oppenheimer category correction
records.summary: Supports correcting the common claim: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
records.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

records.title: Gayatri mantra care
records.summary: Useful for source context, but learner-facing draft must avoid ritual instruction, pronunciation authority, or initiation claims.
records.boundary: No ritual instruction, initiation advice, or recitation authority.

records.title: Stewardship and restraint
records.summary: Can support a careful answer about possession and restraint if commentary and rights notes are visible.
records.boundary: Do not flatten the verse into wealth advice or productivity advice.

records.title: Modern aircraft overclaim
records.summary: Used to practice refusing inflated claims when no source can carry the answer.
records.boundary: Say no reliable source is present; do not invent validation.

rules.title: No loose sentences
rules.copy: A sentence without source, reason, or boundary cannot be promoted.

rules.title: No hidden authority
rules.copy: The answer must not sound like scripture, guru, clinician, or ritual authority.

rules.title: No category blur
rules.copy: Veda, Upanishad, Gita, commentary, and modern interpretation stay labeled.

example.learner_question: How can I act calmly when results are uncertain?

answer_sentences.sentence: Begin with the next honest action.
Do not turn the result into your identity.

example.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, ritual instruction, or guaranteed peace.
